observations: Multiple blue gas cylinders stored indoors.
White 'Ar' lettering painted on the side of the cylinders.
Cylinders are fitted with protective valve caps.
One cylinder in the foreground has a white plastic seal over the valve area.
Watermark 'RECHIN INTEGRATED SERVICES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' visible on the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show the technical stamps on the cylinder shoulder indicating water capacity.
No pressure gauge is visible in the photos to confirm the contents.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or have low pressure.
risks.proof: A photo or video of a regulator/gauge attached to the cylinder showing 150 bar pressure.

risks.risk: The cylinder capacity may be less than 6m3.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the shoulder stamps showing the Water Capacity (WC) in liters.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be out of its hydro-test safety period.
risks.proof: A photo of the most recent hydro-test date stamped on the cylinder shoulder.
risks.if_unproven: as an expired cylinder requiring re-testing

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the technical stamps on the cylinder shoulder (WC, test dates, working pressure).
Photo of a pressure gauge connected to one of the cylinders showing the current pressure.
response.reason: The value of industrial gas depends entirely on the volume of the cylinder and the pressure of the gas inside, neither of which can be verified from the current photo. Technical stamps on the cylinder shoulder are required to confirm the size and safety status.
